summary: Frontend-only verification of ATR tracking UI (AtrTracking), FormAlert and operator-contacts panel. All requested flows PASS: is_test ATR record created via API -> atr-tracking panel visible with status 'ciornă'; register -> 'înregistrat' + atr-due-check (10 working days: 10.01->23.01 correct); complete -> 'dosar complet' + atr-due-issue (15.01+30=14.02); issued with separate atr_date -> 'aviz emis', header shows Nr. înregistrare + ATR no/date, events listed (4 events); terms editor check_days 10->12 saved, summary text updated. Send with incomplete dossier (test@distributie-energie.ro, confirm accepted) -> error toast listing 5 missing docs; non-official domain (x@gmail.com) -> domain error toast. No email sent. form-alert-atr shown in DEER ATR record when 'ATR consum' official_form set to 'versiune nouă detectată' (restored to 'valid'). /formulare-oficiale: admin sees operator-contacts with contact-deer/delgaz/rer/oltenia; invalid-domain contact rejected with toast; active subscriber does NOT see operator-contacts (forms-list visible). All test data cleaned up.

ui_bugs.issue: useState initialised once at mount (details renders TermsEditor immediately); after register/complete in same session, 'Termen verificare'/'Termen aviz' date inputs stay empty (and check_days etc. also stale vs t.terms). Backend ignores empty values so no data loss, but user sees blank current dates. Add useEffect to resync v from t/terms, or key TermsEditor by t.check_due+t.issue_due.

operator contacts are empty by default, so atr-send-to is empty and atr-send-btn disabled until admin configures /formulare-oficiale contacts or user types an address. Consider a hint text when no default address is configured.
After invalid-domain address rejected, input keeps invalid value (defaultValue, uncontrolled) — looks saved though it isn't. Revert to last saved value on error.

action_items: LOW: resync TermsEditor state when track changes (dates/terms fields stale)
LOW: revert operator contact input on save error
LOW: hint when no default operator address configured
critical_code_review_comments: AtrTracking operator->key mapping duplicated in frontend (includes('delgaz')...) vs backend ATR.op_key; fallback to 'deer' for unknown operators may prefill a wrong distributor address — consider returning default 'to' from /atr/{id}/track.
Sandbox browser clock is Oct 2026, so due badges show 'depășit' — not a bug.
